objective: A context-aware structured/typed/hierarchical agent facade enabling current on-demand reads of every authorized datum for the teacher's students. The whole known interface remains in scope, not only three canaries.

confirmedLatestInterview.priority: Any required teacher-owned student information synchronized from the academy to the connected Backend on demand
confirmedLatestInterview.widerAdminScope: Conditional on a demonstrated required-workflow bottleneck and separately verified authority. Not an automatic privilege expansion.
confirmedLatestInterview.agentMeaning: Agents understand purpose, resource identity, relationships, source/effect/authority, temporal scope and outcome rather than re-discovering routes
confirmedLatestInterview.readRealtimeMeaning: Fresh source acquisition on a requested operation, not an installed continuous replication or a promise to bypass authentication/source outages
confirmedLatestInterview.sourceProviderAssumption: Assume no separately supplied official API/export. Use the teacher-visible current functionality, verified paper/item/student/attempt identifiers and multiple source-specific acquisition paths; do not make official source provision a startup dependency.
confirmedLatestInterview.projectCreation: The user permits additional native Projects in dc-gang-a-dev if useful. Preserve a maintainable directory/ownership tree; this does not approve cloud resources, billing or access changes.
confirmedLatestInterview.webMcpProgression: Build meaningful typed/hierarchical operations linked to qualified current academy functionality incrementally. A browser registration label or item identifier alone does not prove student-specific activity or a production agent facade.

preservedObserverDecisions.sourceServer: Externally owned, read/analyze only; build an agent-facing facade rather than modifying or copying its backend
lanes: Minimal necessary source evidence and accepted-time version
preservedObserverDecisions.outage: Last verified facts remain dated/scoped and visibly unavailable-current; teacher inputs continue without claiming official source save
preservedObserverDecisions.recovery: Input received, history saved/read back, independent copy verified, actual restore verified are distinct states
preservedObserverDecisions.kg: A later consumer; individual mathematics examples are not current architecture prerequisites

repoAssessment.finding: The known endpoint inventory is valuable but all static entries stay non-callable; metadata alone does not satisfy data acquisition.
repoAssessment.disposition: Keep exact original IDs and effect/source provenance; attach qualified per-domain capabilities through the existing consumer, not another endpoint registry.

repoAssessment.finding: The prior three-family reader is a valid bounded acquisition/audit foundation, not complete student history, whole roster, pagination or unattended authentication.
repoAssessment.disposition: Extend through semantic family modules with runtime input/response validation, request-scope coverage, source drift refusal and source-specific joins. Integrate after the publication owner releases its exact merged base.

repoAssessment.finding: The local revision store is explicitly synthetic and its existing whole-partition validation is not a measured large-scale production history implementation.
repoAssessment.disposition: Preserve it as compatibility/recovery rehearsal; do not place real students in it or label it a protected hosted store.

recommendedTargetArchitecture.status: Lead recommendation; implementation/resource selection gates remain
recommendedTargetArchitecture.form: One modular product with ports/adapters and one semantic contract spine, not early microservices or a fleet of parallel state registries
recommendedTargetArchitecture.sourceBoundary: Origin-bound native authentication with reviewed fixed operations; no exported cookie, generic URL dispatcher, simulated backend row or implicit save/generation
recommendedTargetArchitecture.domainBoundary: Separate identity/enrollment/occurrence, assignments/prestudy, assessment attempts/item grades/clinic lanes, shared content/media, teacher review and delivery evidence
recommendedTargetArchitecture.historyBoundary: Append-only teacher/evidence revisions with explicit valid/source-observed/recorded/approved times; current indexed projections remain rebuildable
recommendedTargetArchitecture.storeCandidate: PostgreSQL is the preferred candidate to evaluate for relational identities, constraints, transactions and indexed version/evidence queries; provider selection and provisioning are not approved here
recommendedTargetArchitecture.graphBoundary: Versioned relation/edge tables and recursive queries can support hierarchical traversal initially. A graph projection or separate graph store is justified only by measured query requirements; a database is not the Ontology layer.
recommendedTargetArchitecture.agentBoundary: Describe and validate purpose, input identity, scope, typed result, permitted effect, completeness/unknown states and recovery per tool. Native tool/MCP exposure and browser WebMCP are separate activation decisions.
recommendedTargetArchitecture.multiAgent: Concurrent reads may use bounded acquisition concurrency; retained histories require store-level CAS/idempotency and exact owner scope. Profile/session names are not isolation or locks.

primarySourceFindings.claim: PostgreSQL provides primary/unique/foreign-key constraints. Cross-row restrictions should not be encoded as CHECK constraints that inspect other rows.[2]
primarySourceFindings.implication: Keep identity and relation invariants in appropriate relational constraints rather than only JSON blobs.

primarySourceFindings.claim: JSON document updates acquire a row-level lock on the whole row.[1]
primarySourceFindings.implication: Avoid one giant per-student mutable JSON document; retain bounded versioned payloads beside indexed typed identity columns.

primarySourceFindings.claim: PostgreSQL recursive WITH supports hierarchical traversal and explicit CYCLE detection.[5]
primarySourceFindings.implication: A hierarchy requirement alone does not require an additional graph database. Benchmark representative traversals before selecting one.

primarySourceFindings.claim: PostgreSQL exposes transaction isolation choices; successful Serializable transactions are equivalent to a serial execution order.[8]
primarySourceFindings.implication: Multi-agent history writes need transaction/retry semantics and a persisted idempotency key, not only a hash or in-memory preview.

primarySourceFindings.claim: Neo4j documents uniqueness constraints and marks property-existence/type/key constraints as Enterprise Edition.[7]
primarySourceFindings.implication: Evaluate actual edition/entitlement and operations before assuming a free graph option offers identical integrity guarantees.

primarySourceFindings.claim: Event sourcing introduces substantial schema, concurrency, query and migration trade-offs; Microsoft recommends it when its benefits justify that complexity.[4]
primarySourceFindings.implication: Use append-only evidence/teacher revisions where required without automatically adopting a queue/event-bus architecture for every source entity.

primarySourceFindings.claim: PostgreSQL distinguishes SQL dump, filesystem backup and continuous archiving.[6]
primarySourceFindings.implication: An independent protected recovery destination and actual restore test remain required; local file existence or provider marketing is insufficient.

necessaryAcceptance: For every teacher-owned requested resource, bind exact source subject and resource identity, read all requested pages or explicitly block completeness.
Expose unsupported source fields, native-app-only data, unknown effects and inaccessible history as specific blockers; do not replace them with guessed states.
A fresh-context agent can discover the operation, supply current scope, acquire real source data and consume a typed audited result without route re-discovery.
Test multi-agent read concurrency, source-expiry/drift/outage, duplicate/mismatched identity and teacher correction conflicts at routine workload.
Retained teacher/evidence history survives the explicitly named failure domain with verified audience, identities/counts/revisions and real restore output.
Measure required production-scale query and backup/restore performance rather than infer scalability from a small synthetic test.
